formulas.effective_volume: Integral_V[(sigma_tensile(x)/sigma_max)^m dV] for one positive principal direction
formulas.effective_surface: Integral_A[(sigma_tensile(x)/sigma_max)^m dA] for one positive principal direction
formulas.multiple_principal_stresses: PIA sums positive-principal-direction terms; other multiaxial models need corresponding calibration.
formulas.beam_A_eff: [b+h/(m+1)]*L_eff; bottom plus tensile portions of two sides
formulas.Ct_definition: peak positive principal tensile stress / nominal compressive membrane stress
formulas.contact_size_adjustment: sigma_target_contact=sigma_target_full*(Q_full/Q_contact_eff)^(1/m); same population and hazard allocation only
formulas.competing_independent_flaw_populations: H_total=H_volume+H_surface+H_edge+... after independent population-specific calibrations. Do not select the strongest separate prediction; absent calibration does not establish zero hazard.

uncomputed_scenarios.reason: Reference coupon effective size absent. No invented volume or adoption of SA bar geometry.
Compression flaw mechanism/distribution and scale transfer absent; tensile Weibull data cannot establish it.
uncomputed_scenarios.input_interpretation: Assumptions only; 380 is a flexural catalog value,3900 a typical coupon compression value, neither an assembly allowable.

limitations: SA380MPa is only a typical value; mean interpretation and40/20mm spans are explicit assumptions.
m8 andm10 originate from different manufacturer versions; no population confidence bounds.
Full-volume/full-surface uniform tension is hypothetical; baseline midspan is entirely compressive.
Surface and volume scenarios are alternate calibrations, not two independent hazards calibrated by the same dataset.
Microscopic compression damage, splitting, crushing, buckling, and mixed-mode contact require separate models/evidence.
Hong CVD shells are small TRISO-process specimens; no production equivalence to large commercial tubes.
No final-life, handling-damage, environmental, thermal-gradient, proof-test, joint, or common-cause reliability is established.
No numeric point estimate in this file is a confidence-bounded design allowable.
ASME HHB composite-core guidance is contextual only; no monolithic-SiC code qualification established.
Hong coupon scales derived from sample means and fitted m do not exactly recover original maximum-likelihood estimates.

The SA surface and volume examples do not establish which flaw family governs. Actual independently characterized populations contribute additive hazards; taking whichever prediction is stronger is invalid.
